desc: The TLR-7 HL-X USB high-lumen, multi-fuel, rail-mounted light is engineered to produce a longer reaching, tighter beam. Using Streamlight's SL-B9 USB-C rechargeable protected lithium-ion battery pack, the TLR-7 HL-X has an output of 1,000 Lumens and a runtime of up to 1 hour. Interchangeable rear paddle switches accommodate your shooting style.
